title: Contacts export
body:
## Destination

Provide a project-local command that exports the active filtered contacts to CSV.

## Captured user intent

U01 — The user wants to export the existing contacts list without editing contacts.
U02 — The user wants the file saved locally and no network upload.
U03 — Synthetic clarification: export only the active filtered contacts, include every existing field, reject an existing output path without overwriting it, and write only the field-name header for an empty selection.

## Context and sources

This is a fictional format example, not a claim about an inspected project.
The only source for its requirements is the fictional intent and clarification above.

## In scope

Export the active filtered contacts and all their existing fields to one user-selected new local CSV file.

## Out of scope

Editing contacts, cloud synchronization, and automatic scheduling.

## Task requirements

### REQ-001 — Export the filtered contacts
- Requirement: Export only the contacts in the active filtered view as a local CSV file, including every existing field.
- Source: U01 — example user intent.
- Source: U03 — synthetic clarification of selection and fields.
- Acceptance: The exported file contains exactly the contacts in the active filtered view and all their existing fields; excluded contacts are absent and source records remain unchanged.
- Acceptance: An empty filtered view produces a CSV header with the existing field names and no data rows.
- Depends on: None.

### REQ-002 — Keep the export local
- Requirement: Save the CSV at the new local path selected by the user without uploading it or overwriting an existing file.
- Source: U02 — example user intent.
- Source: U03 — synthetic clarification of overwrite behavior.
- Acceptance: At a new path the file exists and the export makes no network upload; at an existing path the operation reports a conflict and leaves that file unchanged.
- Depends on: REQ-001
